previous_action: Gaius Maximus Valerius personally leads the expedition farther into the country used by the regional band. He keeps the main body concentrated around his own position, continues to use the ravine fortress and forward camp as linked bases, and presses the search for the network sustaining the band. He gives his officers freedom to report what they discover without telling them what result he expects, intending to let the country and the movement of men reveal what comes next.

continuity.campaign_development: Valerius now personally leads the main expedition deeper into the regional band's country. The ravine fortress and forward camp remain linked bases, while scouting and traveler reports continue to reveal fragments of the band's wider network. A second concealed store has been located, and a difficult crossing has been prepared for the march ahead.
continuity.land_area_history: Round 33 establishes 4.00 square miles as the measured starting footprint of Valerius's personal estates and holdings. The measurement reflects land already accumulated through prior simulation events and adds no new property. The value remains fixed unless a later event explicitly acquires, loses, transfers, or otherwise changes land.
